designer.name: Faraz Khan
designer.focus: Enterprise data UX and AI-native product design

note: This structured index exists so AI readers can parse the portfolio directly. Self-initiated concepts are reconstructed from secondary research with no primary research, metrics, or usability tests claimed.

caseStudies.title: FinVista
caseStudies.summary: Native Android loan origination system across 6 loan products, with a 100+ component design system and a streamlined 11-step two-wheeler loan journey.

caseStudies.title: Aurora
caseStudies.domain: Marketing campaign platform with embedded AI
caseStudies.summary: Redesigned the Recurring Batch Journey configurator and embedded the Helio AI composer; cut campaign-setup clicks 3:1 and shipped a 52-component design system.

caseStudies.title: Meridian Institute Analytics
caseStudies.summary: Unified four siloed Power BI dashboards (undergraduate and graduate admissions, research, HR) into one platform with an overview-and-drill-down model and an optional AI layer. Client anonymized.

caseStudies.title: Jack of All Threads
caseStudies.summary: End-to-end product for India's first t-shirt crowdfunding platform: an in-browser design studio, the campaign-creation flow, and the buyer and raiser journeys across desktop and mobile.

concepts.title: Slate
concepts.domain: AI recruiting workspace for staffing agencies
concepts.posture: Reconstructed from secondary research; no primary research or metrics claimed.
concepts.summary: The AI sources candidates, ranks them, and drafts outreach while the recruiter stays the decision-maker. Designed end to end and built as a working interactive prototype.

concepts.title: Crux — the Control Room
concepts.domain: AI-agent supervision console for enterprise analytics (BFSI)
concepts.posture: Reconstructed from secondary research; no primary research, users, or metrics claimed. States what could not be validated and how it would be.
concepts.summary: A working prototype of an AI-agent supervision console that renders the five Agent Experience trust patterns as real interface: intent preview, autonomy dial with live work re-routing, calibrated confidence that forces escalation below threshold, an action audit with before/after diffs and incident replay, and an escalation pathway with a full context package.
